product.olivetti-m15-plus.summary: 1988 80C88 portable with 512 KB, a detachable keyboard and a backlit monochrome LCD. An experimental dual-floppy pilot is available.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.history: The M15 Plus is a distinct successor within Olivetti's M15 portable family. It combined an 80C88 at 4.77 MHz, 512 KB, a detachable keyboard and a 10.5-inch backlit LCD. Olivetti sold either two internal 720 KB floppy drives or one floppy with a 20 MB HDU. The current pilot represents only the dual-floppy configuration.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.warning: EXPERIMENTAL PILOT: POST, resets, 512 KB, original media boot and documented display modes are validated. The HDU remains unavailable; exact LCD response and board logic are approximate, while final validation of the new EDIT/SHIFT model is pending.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.creation.varia: One internal 720 KB floppy drive and 20 MB HDU
product.olivetti-m15-plus.creation.note: Olivetti sold both configurations. This pilot can currently create only the two-internal-floppy model; the optional external 360 KB drive is not represented.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.creation.hdu_n: The documented 20 MB HDU model is shown but disabled: BIOS 1.10 uses ports 320h-323h, but the controller identity, command protocol, IRQ/DMA routing and disk geometry are still unknown.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.cpu_: Intel 80C88 at 4.77 MHz with 512 KB user RAM. The available emulator core and calibrated timer remain timing approximations.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.vide: Backlit super-twist monochrome LCD. The original utility names black, six grey levels and white; the Plus renderer preserves those eight levels with an approximate luminance curve. The guide documents 40/80-column text and 320×200/640×200 graphics; a brochure's conflicting 640×320 claim is not exposed as an emulated mode.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.swit: BIOS 1.10 decodes the same multiplexed memory and 40/80-column startup bits as M15. Memory is fixed at the documented 512 KB; Configure exposes only the firmware-backed startup text choice.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.firm: Local BIOS 1.10: 32 KB mapped at F8000h-FFFFFh, reset date 06/03/88. It remains local-only pending provenance and rights verification.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.impl: The pilot reuses the evidence-backed M15-family board-switch, MSM6242 RTC and V6355D compatibility paths while preserving a separate machine identity and 32 KB firmware map. Its latching EDIT/SHIFT transformations follow the manual and the alternate F1-F10 codes observed in KBD.CUS.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.stat: Cold boot and both reset paths pass Resident Diagnostics and report 512/512 KB. Original media boots under MS-DOS 3.20; its configuration report identifies both internal 720 KB drives. The customer Memory, System Board and Display LCD tests pass, validating the character set, attributes, eight ordered shades and 320×200/640×200 graphics.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.limi: The proprietary HDU is absent; exact physical LCD response, timer calibration, FDC electronics and remaining custom board logic are approximate or unknown. EDIT/SHIFT is implemented but awaits its final original-utility run. The documented 640×320 claim remains unresolved against the diagnostic's 640×200 mode.
